bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: I would never see it; it only shapes which proof the company asks me for.
bundles.why: It happens before I apply and I cannot see it, though I like that asked items match real job requirements.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: Right after I send my CV, when the company reads my degree and GitHub from it.
bundles.why: I care that my personal details are removed, but I never see this screen myself.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: When I either get the proof email or a rejection a few days after applying.
bundles.why: A person confirming the shortlist makes me trust that a machine did not just throw my CV away.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: On the bus after a night shift, opening the email link on my phone to upload my degree and GitHub link.
bundles.why: This is what I actually use; it must say who sees my documents and why, show my file was received, and work on a phone, or I will think it is a scam.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: When I get an email saying I was not selected and I wonder what I lacked.
bundles.why: Specific reasons help me improve, and it is better than silence, but I can live without it.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: I would never meet it; it is only for the HR lead.
bundles.why: It shows only totals and does not touch me, though knowing no ranked individuals are shown is mildly reassuring.

proof_timing.why: I would not upload my certificate to an unknown company just to apply, since it looks like a scam, but once shortlisted and told why, I would send it.
